sloka: पादपान् अवभन्जन्तो विकर्षन्तस् तथा लताः ।विधमन्तो गिरि वरान् प्रययुः प्लवग ऋषभाः ॥६-४-९२॥।।
transliteration: pādapān avabhanjanto vikarṣantas tathā latāḥ ।vidhamanto giri varān prayayuḥ plavaga ṛṣabhāḥ ॥6-4-92॥।।

translations.english: The vanaras (who are best among leaping animals) went smashing the trees, pulling out the creepers and purposefully destroying the mountains (on their way).
